title: NP-hardness of Gaussian c-separation
summary: A Lean 4 proof development of reduction idea toward NP-hardness of feature selection for relative Gaussian c-separation in the formulation of Borozan et al. The argument starts from NP-completeness of equal-cardinality partition of positive squares, giving integral Gaussian data via integer roots and an even paired total. Three Gaussians enforce partition balance, and a schedule of d+1 Gaussians enforces binary selectors. Explicit separation of the two blocks makes cross-block hinge penalties vanish.
